versions.name: Camp Avantura BSA
versions.address: Autokamp Veli Joze, Borozija 3C, 52475 Savudrija, Croatia
versions.summary: Transatlantic Council seaside Scouts BSA resident camp in Savudrija, offering the ACE first-year program, merit badges in aquatics, outdoor skills, handicrafts, and science, plus IOLS adult training.

The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Website repaired 2026-07-25: the stored link was a registration portal (https://scoutingevent.com/802-CampAvantura2026); replaced with the council's own camp page, found by tools/find_camp_pages.py and confirmed to name the camp.
